name: NHS & respiratory
summary: UKHSA 5 Nov: flu low with variable trends, COVID low and falling, RSV rising at baseline; next update 12 Nov
state: UKHSA's update of 5 Nov for week 44 says flu is low with variable trends: positivity rose to 7.6% from 6.8% and hospital admissions to 2.83 per 100,000 from 2.51. COVID-19 is low and falling, while RSV positivity rose to 2.9% from 1.6% and is at baseline, with admissions rising mainly in children under 5. UKHSA expects flu and RSV to rise in the coming weeks; no widespread critical incidents were found as of 10 Nov, so Normal is kept.
for_you: UKHSA and the NHS advise eligible groups, including over-65s, pregnant women and young children, to take up flu, COVID-19 and RSV vaccines before winter activity rises.
rubric_hit: UKHSA: flu low, RSV at baseline; no widespread critical incidents (Normal)
